mapper.select: SELECT id, initial_screen, default_work_minutes, default_priority, week_start, calendar_start, calendar_end, holidays_enabled, notifications_enabled, task_start_notice_minutes, due_notice_minutes, quiet_start, quiet_end, notification_sound_enabled FROM app_settings WHERE id = 1
